name: Healthcare & Cost Architecture
summary: A regulated healthcare platform, end to end: decomposing an on-premise clinical monolith, integrating medical-IoT devices over HL7, real-time clinical analytics, a network with no public ingress, and a gated delivery pipeline.
intro: The platform had to grow beyond its on-premise hardware without putting clinical data or uptime at risk. These case studies cover the application decomposition, the device-integration tier, the analytics pipeline that took reporting load off the live database, the network and access model, and the CI/CD pipeline that ships to it.

name: Enterprise Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure
summary: Hybrid infrastructure spanning AWS, an on-prem VMware data center, and a private OpenStack cloud: a 21+ node Oracle RAC cluster on AWS, a shared S3-compatible storage layer, and automated mail disaster recovery.
intro: Three pieces of an enterprise estate that had to work across public cloud, on-premise virtualization, and a private cloud at once — active-active database clustering without native shared storage, one object-storage API for every environment, and a mail platform that recovers in minutes instead of hours.
